bio: Electrical and Electronics Engineering student focused on building automated assessment systems and embedded hardware. Founder of Proctor AI, Kaggle Expert (Top 1%), and Chief Trainer for the Kenya Mathematical Olympiad.

about.approach: My approach to engineering is centered on practical utility and technical rigor. I enjoy bridging the gap between hardware and software, whether that involves designing PCBs, developing embedded firmware, or training deep learning models. I prioritize building reliable, functional systems that address real-world constraints over theoretical complexity.
about.lookingFor: Currently developing Proctor AI and open to technical collaborations, machine learning research partnerships, and opportunities in embedded systems, educational tools, and hardware-software co-design.
about.beyond: When I'm not training models or debugging hardware, I train high school students for national and international mathematics and informatics Olympiads. Outside of tech, I spend time exploring classical music (piano, violin composition, and Mozart's Requiem), pencil drawing, and analytic number theory.
